task.instruction: Synthesize an investigation narrative. Treat the supplied records as the complete synthetic evidence set and make one selection for each declared decision.

evidence.content: The maintenance map shows shared power between the crossings, and the incident note records a cracked housing only at the trailhead.
A constructed trail-sensor study records a pulse at one trailhead and repeated small pulses at two downstream crossings.
This synthetic synthesize record for case-research-a19 is bounded to the named observation and constraint. A valid conclusion must distinguish them, cite both, and avoid an unstated factual claim.

A.content: Prefer a bounded intervention at the immediate decision point when wider changes are not required by the evidence.

B.content: Prefer an intervention that accounts for connected incentives and downstream effects when the evidence shows they matter.

irrelevant.content: Keep the artifact title concise enough to fit on one line.
